column1: # Every file in tracing/, with where it was collected from. Identical copies found elsewhere are listed in also_at.
# Location prefixes: repo: = this repository before the clean-up; snapshots/ = the (unpublished) scratch folder of
# per-pass outputs; scratch-build: / scratch-ending: = the agents' temporary scratchpads of the build session and of
# the continuation + ending session. See README.md.
# Files are deduplicated by content (each distinct file copied once) except where a script imports or reads a helper by
# name from its own folder: that identical helper is kept there too, and its also_at column says so.
